headline: Approved awarding bids for third-party testing at the DUAL LANGUAGE PK 8 SCHOOL and fitness equipment at El Centro Community Center.
summary: Third-party testing for the DUAL LANGUAGE PK 8 SCHOOL went to Prime Consulting, the lowest bidder, after the city's project manager recommended it. Fitness equipment for El Centro Community Center went to Advantage Sport & Fitness, which was not the lowest bidder; the recommendation cited its ability to meet the delivery schedule, its familiarity with the building, and its past work with the project architect.
decisions: Approved awarding Bid # 2026-0009 for third-party testing to Prime Consulting, 2-0.
Approved awarding Bid # 2026-0008 for El Centro fitness equipment to Advantage Sport & Fitness, 2-0.

plain_text:
City of Central Falls 
Purchasing Board  
Central Falls City Hall, 
3rd floor Conference Room  
580 Broad St., Central Falls, RI 02863 
Wednesday October 14, 2026 
1:30 PM 
 
 
Posted Wednesday 7, 2027 
 
Agenda 
 
 
Roll Call 
Mayor Rivera opened the meeting at 1:38pm.  Present were Mayor Maria Rivera and Mary Signer, Finance 
Director for the City of Central Falls . The meeting had a quorum.   
 
BID Award The is item may be voted on 
a) Bid # 2026-0009 Third Party Testing DUAL LANGUAGE PK 8 SCHOOL 
The City Clerk/Purchasing Agent addressed the Board and provided an overview of the procurement 
process, noting that the City received three proposals from John Turner, Prime Consulting, and Briggs 
Construction. He further explained that the City’s Owner’s Project Manager (OPM), Peregrine Group, 
reviewed the submissions and recommended awarding the bid to Prime Consulting which was the lowest 
bidder. Following the discussion, a motion to approve the recommendation was made by Mary Signer and 
seconded by Mayor Rivera. The motion passed unanimously, 2-0. 
 
b) Bid # 2026-0008 El Centro Community Center Fitness Equipment 
The City Clerk/Purchasing Agent addressed the Board and provided an overview of the procurement 
process, noting that the City received three proposals from Advantage Sport & Fitness, Precision Fitness 
Equipment, and BSN Sports. The recommendation to award the contract to Advantage Sport & Fitness, 
which was not the lowest bidder, was based on the vendor’s ability to meet the required delivery schedule, 
familiarity with the building, and prior experience collaborating with the project architect. 
 
Following the discussion, a motion to approve the recommendation was made by Mary Signer and seconded 
by Mayor Rivera. The motion passed unanimously, 2-0. 
 
Adjournment   
A motion to adjourn was made by Mary Signer and second by Mayor Rivera.  The meeting 
adjourned at 1:41pm
